command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo

$handled='if(& git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/definitely-missing-flyexplorer-ref"){throw "unexpected"}; Write-Host "INNER_HANDLED=PASS"'
& powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command $handled
$handledCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "CHILD_HANDLED_EXIT=$handledCode"
if($handledCode -ne 0){throw "handled child should exit 0"}

$bare='& cmd /c exit 7'
& powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command $bare
$bareCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "CHILD_BARE_EXIT=$bareCode"
if($bareCode -eq 0){throw "bare failing native child should be nonzero"}

$throwing='throw "intentional child terminating error"'
& powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command $throwing
$throwCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "CHILD_THROW_EXIT=$throwCode"
if($throwCode -eq 0){throw "throwing child should be nonzero"}

$normal='Write-Host "INNER_NORMAL=PASS"'
& powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command $normal
$normalCode=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "CHILD_NORMAL_EXIT=$normalCode"
if($normalCode -ne 0){throw "normal child should exit 0"}

& cmd /c exit 0
Write-Host "POWERSHELL_CHILD_EXIT_SEMANTICS=PASS"
